specialists.name: aio-compound
specialists.purpose: Capture a verified backend investigation as a searchable original lesson when its causal reasoning is absent from code, tests and existing docs; update stale lessons instead of creating duplicates. Use after non-obvious agent, pipeline, data or recovery work is solved.

specialists.name: aio-handoff
specialists.purpose: Save a concise, source-anchored backend execution handoff that another session can safely resume.

specialists.name: aio-resume
specialists.purpose: Resume the exact saved backend run after reconciling its ledger with current source and evidence.

specialists.name: aio-worktree
specialists.purpose: Set up isolated backend work ownership without discarding or silently copying unrelated changes.

specialists.name: aio-ci
specialists.purpose: Follow required backend PR or build checks to an observed terminal result without inventing CI success.

specialists.name: aio-commit
specialists.purpose: Create a focused local commit after inspecting owned backend changes and validation evidence.

specialists.name: aio-feedback
specialists.purpose: Resolve backend PR review feedback with evidence, scoped repairs and renewed checks.

specialists.name: aio-release
specialists.purpose: Prepare and verify backend rollout, compatibility, canary signals and recovery before authorized deployment.

specialists.name: aio-ship
specialists.purpose: Deliver a verified backend change locally, through a requested PR, or to an authorized deployment target. Use for shipping after implementation/review or refreshing a PR description; follows exact-head CI and reports pending or blocked states truthfully.

specialists.name: aio-brainstorm
specialists.purpose: Explore ambiguous backend, API, agent or workflow ideas into a bounded requirements brief with alternatives and observable success. Use before architecture or planning when the outcome or scope is unsettled.

specialists.name: aio-ideate
specialists.purpose: Generate and rank backend or agent-system approaches before committing to a design.

specialists.name: aio-prototype
specialists.purpose: Run a bounded backend architecture spike to resolve a specific technical uncertainty.

specialists.name: aio-spec
specialists.purpose: Turn accepted backend behavior into versioned requirements, interfaces and acceptance criteria.

specialists.name: aio-agents
specialists.purpose: Engineer agent state, tool authority, model decisions, budgets and durable checkpoint recovery.

specialists.name: aio-algorithms
specialists.purpose: Build and verify backend algorithms with independent oracles and explicit resource bounds.

specialists.name: aio-api
specialists.purpose: Build or evolve backend API, webhook and event contracts with security and compatibility checks.

specialists.name: aio-data
specialists.purpose: Plan and implement backend schemas, transactions, tenant access and compatible data migrations.

specialists.name: aio-debug
specialists.purpose: Diagnose a backend bug, failed test, CI failure, agent/tool issue or pipeline incident by reproducing it, tracing boundaries and testing a causal hypothesis before a targeted fix. Use when behavior is unexplained or previous patches have not resolved it.

specialists.name: aio-pipelines
specialists.purpose: Engineer queue jobs, durable workflows, DAGs and backfills with explicit recovery semantics.

specialists.name: aio-tdd
specialists.purpose: Implement changed backend behavior through observed failing tests, minimal fixes and refactoring.

specialists.name: aio-work
specialists.purpose: Implement an accepted backend plan or concrete build request through test-first units, ordered spec and risk reviews, and integrated verification. Use for backend execution or resuming an exact implementation run; use aio-debug for unexplained failures.

specialists.name: aio-explain
specialists.purpose: Explain a backend or agent workflow from actual code, state, data and failure boundaries.

specialists.name: aio-canary
specialists.purpose: Observe a bounded backend canary or post-deploy window against identified baselines, configured thresholds and real functional effects. Use for baseline capture or deployment health checks; rollout and rollback require existing authorization.

specialists.name: aio-observe
specialists.purpose: Establish backend and agent telemetry, operational checks and actionable recovery signals.

specialists.name: aio-optimize
specialists.purpose: Diagnose and improve backend performance using representative profiles and correctness checks.

specialists.name: aio-architecture
specialists.purpose: Design backend and AI agent execution architecture with typed state, authority boundaries, durable recovery, interfaces and resource budgets. Use for consequential architecture choices or workflow design before implementation.

specialists.name: aio-autoplan
specialists.purpose: Automatically refine and independently review an executable backend plan, with scope and developer-interface checks before engineering review. Use for autoplan or automatic backend planning; return to an authorized build controller without starting another pipeline.

specialists.name: aio-plan
specialists.purpose: Create an execution-ready backend implementation plan with stable requirements, owned units, exact interfaces, test-first verification and a dependency graph. Use for multi-step backend, agent, pipeline or algorithm work before changing production code.

specialists.name: aio-plan-review
specialists.purpose: Check a backend implementation plan for requirement coverage, feasibility and adversarial failures.

specialists.name: aio-devex-review
specialists.purpose: Review the actual backend API, SDK or CLI developer journey, examples, errors and compatibility. Use to measure integration friction and diagnose developer-facing contract gaps; report-only unless fixes are authorized.

specialists.name: aio-doc-review
specialists.purpose: Review backend plans, API contracts and runbooks for contradictions, gaps and stale operational claims.

specialists.name: aio-review
specialists.purpose: Review a named backend diff or PR against its contract, then inspect correctness, security, test quality and failure recovery. Use for unit, fix-range or whole-change review with evidence-backed findings; report-only unless applying fixes is requested.

specialists.name: aio-security
specialists.purpose: Audit backend trust boundaries, agent tools, tenant access and data exposure. Default to static inspection; use controlled reproduction and authorized hardening when requested.

specialists.name: aio-simplify
specialists.purpose: Simplify backend changes without weakening contracts, failure behavior or test coverage.

specialists.name: aio-test-audit
specialists.purpose: Audit the value of existing backend tests with a bounded shortlist, actual callers and regression evidence. Use for test-suite cleanup or confidence gaps; report-only unless test changes are authorized.

specialists.name: aio-benchmark
specialists.purpose: Run a fair, predeclared backend comparison of two or three workflows chosen from All in One, Compound Engineering and Superpowers using the same task, model settings and evaluator. Use when evidence is needed for a scoped quality or performance claim.

specialists.name: aio-checkpoint
specialists.purpose: Reconcile backend plan, units, review and verification evidence before advancing a pipeline stage.

specialists.name: aio-proof
specialists.purpose: Collect reproducible backend acceptance evidence bound to source and candidate artifacts.

specialists.name: aio-qa
specialists.purpose: Explore backend API, CLI, job, worker and webhook behavior, then repair authorized reproducible defects and verify durable outcomes. Use for backend QA, quick QA or replaying a prior regression report; use aio-qa-only for report-only inspection.

specialists.name: aio-qa-only
specialists.purpose: Report-only backend functional QA using Full, Quick or Regression exploration. Reproduce defects and retain evidence without repairing code, changing dependencies or shipping. Use for qa-only, an inspection-only QA report or verifying a previous failure report.

specialists.name: aio-test
specialists.purpose: Design and run backend boundary tests, fault injection and independent correctness oracles.

specialists.name: aio-verify
specialists.purpose: Verify backend acceptance and completion against fresh tests, source snapshots and delivery evidence. Use before closing or shipping backend work, checking completion claims, or reporting configured local health checks.
